summary:
Iteration 70 — targeted re-test of the two items requested: (T1-T4) RoomTutorial auto-start + RoomCoach walkthrough, (O1-O7) wall openings (doors/windows). All live-execution was done against https://image-render-test.preview.emergentagent.com/sketches/draw?projectId=p1 at 768×1024 with the seed described in the request (room_tutorial_done CLEARED, app_language='de'). After ~30 min of driving attempts the testing agent was unable to script the two foundational gestures the rest of the test depends on: (a) opening the Polygon drawing sub-tool and getting canvas click events to register as polygon vertices (clicking the text 'Polygon' selects the icon visually but the subsequent canvas clicks do not plot vertices — Elemente remains 0; iter_69 drove this exact flow but via a different click target), (b) performing a reliable long-press on a measured line to open OpeningInsertMenu (iter_69 did get this to work with mouse.down + 900 ms hold + mouse.up, but requires a polygon to exist). Without a closed polygon the auto-tutorial cannot fire, RoomCoach cannot be meaningfully walked (every step after 'Raum zeichnen' depends on practiceRoom being defined), and openings O1-O7 cannot be exercised live.

What was confirmed live this run (new vs. iter_69):
  • Editor still loads cleanly at 768×1024 with the seed; no PAGEERROR, no CONSOLE[error].
  • With app_language='de' in localStorage the toolbar labels DO render in German (Stift / Linie / Kreis / Rechteck / Winkel / Memo / Text / Notiz / Maßlinie / Polygon / +Pkt / -Pkt / Raster / Zeichenleiste / Bearbeiten / Punkte / Stil ändern / Element löschen / Vor-Zurück / Zoom / Position / Zuschneiden / Foto / Seite löschen) — the mixed-locale observation from iter_69 is resolved when app_language is explicitly seeded. Not a product change — just confirmation that the pre-existing i18n fallback is responsible.
  • ROOM_TUTORIAL_KEY ('aufmassprofi_room_tutorial_done') is confirmed unset after navigation to /sketches/draw?projectId=p1 — the key is NOT written on load (that part of the gate is correct).
  • Code audit of the auto-trigger (/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:1456-1471) matches the request description: setAutoTutorial(true) is gated on previous===0 && closedRoomCount>=1 && !practiceStashRef.current && now - editorOpenedAt >= 2500 ms && !AsyncStorage[ROOM_TUTORIAL_KEY]. The 2500 ms grace period is correct and avoids firing while an existing sketch is being loaded.
  • Code audit of RoomTutorial.tsx STEPS array = 10 entries and 'Schritt 1 von 10' label matches; onPractice callback is wired through RoomTutorialModal → draw.tsx startPractice (line 1399). startPractice correctly stashes the real state (elements/history/historyIndex/lineSegmentMeasurements/polygonWalls/polygonAreaOptions/polygonAreaShapes/labelOffsets/measureLineStyles) in practiceStashRef and empties them. endPractice restores them from the stash — so T4 (practice does not pollute the real sketch) is wired correctly in source.
  • performAutoSaveRef.current is swapped to a no-op while practice===true (draw.tsx:1481) → practice sketch cannot be auto-saved. Good.
  • RoomCoach practiceStatus (lines 1445-1455) derives every flag from read-only state: no setState in the derivation, roomClosed from practiceRoom, allMeasured from computePolygon, pointsKey/openingKey from JSON.stringify snapshots — correct for the 'advance exactly when condition met' requirement. latest/start refs in RoomCoach.tsx:48-54 are correctly cleaned up on unmount.

What was not driven live and the reason:
  • T1 auto-start: could not close a polygon via Playwright clicks on the SVG canvas in this run (clicks at computed canvas coords did not add vertices; Elemente stayed at 0). Suspect: either the Polygon tool activation required a two-step 'Polygon' → sub-icon selection, or the polygon-sub-palette (seen as '+Pkt / -Pkt' in the DOM) requires the user to first pick the polygon start mode. iter_69 successfully drew a 4-point polygon in the same build, so the capability exists — the gating is my selector choice, not a product bug. Not tested: 10-page carousel paging, Zurück/Weiter enablement, Fertig closes modal, reload-after-key-persists.
  • T2 practice entry from tutorial / from 'Mehr' menu: not exercised. 'Mehr' → 'Tutorial: Räume, Türen & Fenster' + the green 'Selbst ausprobieren' CTA were both confirmed present in iter_69; the onPractice wiring in RoomTutorial.tsx:221-224 unconditionally calls onClose() then onPractice() which in turn calls startPractice() in draw.tsx. Code-review verdict: should work.
  • T3 RoomCoach walkthrough: not exercised end-to-end. The 9 steps and their done() predicates read correctly from code; concern areas for the main agent to self-test — (i) step 4 ('eine Ecke verschieben') requires s.pointsKey !== start.pointsKey, and start.current is the snapshot at the moment step 3 (allMeasured) completed. After entering measurements the panel is open and pointsKey has already been snapshotted; good. (ii) step 5 ('Diagonale eingeben') done=determined — the coach claims the app 'has already selected the diagonal field', please verify this actually happens (I could not find a setNumpadTargetId call in draw.tsx tied to the pointsKey change that would switch focus to a diagonal field after a point move). (iii) step 8 ('Öffnung einfügen') is gated solely on openingCount>0, so inserting a door via the +Tür preset in WallHeightSection also advances the coach — that is acceptable as a fallback to long-press. (iv) step 9 ('Öffnung verschieben') requires openingKey !== start.openingKey; dragging the opening on web depends on touchHandlers.ts PanResponder working under react-native-web — on web preview this is historically unreliable (same reason long-press is fiddly). If a user on a real device can drag, this step works; on Playwright web it may stay stuck.
  • T4 side effects after practice: endPractice is correctly wired; could not verify live.
  • O1-O7: all require a measured polygon as a prerequisite — not exercised live this run. Code review (iter_69 + this run):
     • openingConflict() (/app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts:47-59) returns 'outside' when offset+width > lineMeters+0.005 (⚠ for O2: 'ragt über die Linie hinaus (…)' is rendered inline — but the input field is only marked red via the 'invalid' prop; the invalid offset STILL goes into state because setOpening in WallHeightSection:147 writes raw text — the validation is read-only. That matches 'no invalid offset is stored' only loosely: the raw text IS stored, but openingOffsetMeters/openingConflict mark it invalid for wall-area math. Please confirm this is the intended UX.
     • Comma vs dot: parseMeasurementToMeters in polygonArea.ts replaces ',' with '.' — '1,00' and '1.00' both parse to 1.0; text garbage parses to NaN → openingOffsetMeters returns null → conflict null → no error indicator (this is a minor gap: text garbage should ideally show 'bitte Zahl eingeben' — code review comment).
     • Negative offset: parseFloat('-0,5') → -0.5; start+width = -0.5+0.885 = 0.385 ≤ lineMeters so 'outside' is NOT raised for negative offsets. Potential bug — report below.
     • Overlap prevention via drag: openingPlacement() in wallArea.ts:24-45 clamps the drop position into the free gaps between neighbours → drag cannot overlap. Good.
     • Overlap prevention via typed offset: openingConflict returns 'overlap' when start < otherStart+otherWidth-0.005 && otherStart < start+width-0.005 — only shows the inline warning; the offset text is still stored. Same UX note as O2.
     • Type switch Tür/Fenster/Sonstiges: WallHeightSection.tsx:117-129, each kind is a TouchableOpacity with testID 'wall-opening-kind-door-{i}' / '-window-{i}' / '-other-{i}'. Clean.
     • 'Auf andere Linie kopieren': testID 'wall-opening-copy-{i}' toggles copyIndex in parent; next tap on another line in the sketch triggers the copy — this cross-component handshake (WallHeightSection ↔ draw.tsx hitTest tap) could NOT be exercised live.
     • Persistence: performSaveImpl + loadSketch include polygonWalls → openings should round-trip. Code-reviewed only.
     • Geraderücken (O7): straightenPolygon() ties the clicked line as the anchor; openings are stored as offset/position on the segment and should remain on their line. Code-reviewed only.

ui_bugs.issue: Negative typed offset (e.g. '-0,5') is parsed to -0.5 and is NOT flagged by openingConflict() because start+width (0.385 for a 0.885-wide door) is still ≤ lineMeters, so 'outside' is not triggered. Downstream openingOffsetMeters returns a negative value which can shift the opening off the start of the line. Reference: /app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts:47-59 (openingConflict only checks start+width > lineMeters) and :61-67 (openingOffsetMeters does not clamp to ≥0). Suggest adding `if (start < -0.005) return 'outside';` in openingConflict and/or `Math.max(0, …)` in openingOffsetMeters.

Text garbage (e.g. 'abc') typed into the offset field parses to NaN → openingOffsetMeters returns null → no conflict warning is rendered (the field just silently has no effect). Users get no feedback that their input was ignored. Suggest showing the generic '⚠ keine Zahl' hint under the input when parse fails. Reference: /app/frontend/src/sketch/polygonArea.ts parseMeasurementToMeters + WallHeightSection line 149.

integration_issues.issue: Coach text claims the app 'has already selected the diagonal field' after moving a point in step 4, but the testing agent could not find the setNumpadTargetId/setPanelKeyboardOpen path in draw.tsx that auto-focuses the diagonal input when practiceRoom.data.points change. Please verify live: after step 4 completes (pointsKey change), does the LineMeasurePanel actually re-open with the diagonal field focused? If not, update the coach text or wire the auto-focus.

test_report_links: /tmp/t1_editor_loaded.png — editor loaded at 768×1024 with app_language=de seed (German labels confirmed in toolbar)
action_items: (HIGH) Verify negative offset for openings is treated as invalid — openingConflict() in /app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts:47 only guards against overshoot; add a guard for start < 0 and/or clamp in openingOffsetMeters. Reproduce: add door to line 1, type '-0,5' into Abstand ab Linienanfang — expected ⚠ 'Ragt über die Linie hinaus / vor dem Linienanfang', actual: no warning, invalid offset accepted silently.
(MEDIUM) Give a user-visible hint when the Abstand/Breite/Höhe text does not parse to a number (currently silently falls back to no change / no warning).

(MEDIUM) Verify step 5 of RoomCoach ('Diagonale eingeben') actually auto-focuses the diagonal field after a point move, as the coach text claims. If the auto-focus is not implemented, soften the coach text to 'tippe im Feld Diagonale eine Länge ein'.

(MEDIUM) Add stable testIDs for the toolbar tools (polygon-tool / edit-tool / points-tool / pen-tool / rect-tool / circle-tool / line-tool / measure-line-tool / angle-tool / grid-tool / text-tool / memo-tool) and for the Polygon-sub-palette ('+Pkt' / '-Pkt' / 'Linie' close / 'Raum' close) — currently every tool is picked by its localised label, which is brittle. Without these testIDs it is very hard for E2E testing agents to drive the polygon drawing flow reliably.

(MEDIUM) Add a testID on the measured-line SVG element (e.g. `measured-line-{polygonId}-{segmentIndex}`) in renderSketchElement.tsx so that long-press for OpeningInsertMenu can be scripted without geometry calculations.
(LOW) Add a testID on the main sketch canvas container (sketch-canvas) so Playwright does not have to guess which SVG is the active canvas.
critical_code_review_comments: Gate for auto-tutorial (draw.tsx:1461-1471) is correct: ignores existing sketches (previous===0), ignores practice mode, honours ROOM_TUTORIAL_KEY, has a 2500 ms grace to avoid firing while loading. Good.

startPractice/endPractice (draw.tsx:1399-1435) correctly stash and restore every piece of sketch state and do not touch the auto-save (performAutoSaveRef swapped to no-op while practice===true at line 1481). T4 'practice does not pollute real sketch' is wired correctly.

RoomCoach.tsx done() predicates read only from the incoming status (no setState inside render), start.current is captured via useRef at mount and refreshed only after a step completes (line 52), so each step's '!== start.current' comparison is correct. Auto-advance timer 900 ms is cleaned up in the effect return.

openingPlacement()/openingConflict() in wallArea.ts: drag-placement clamps into free gaps between neighbours (cannot overlap) but typed offsets are NOT clamped — they only mark the input red. This is probably intentional (user can still see their typed value) but PLEASE confirm that an opening with a known conflict is EXCLUDED from the wall-area math (grep in wallArea.ts shows deductionM2() iterates openings without conflict filter → it still subtracts the opening even when it is marked 'outside' / 'overlap', which could produce an incorrect wall area). This is worth a direct check by the main agent.
OpeningInsertMenu.tsx is a focused 44-line component with proper testIDs. No issues.

success_rate.frontend: Live-verified this run: 2/18 planned items (editor load with correct seed, DE labels with app_language=de seed). Code-reviewed only for the rest (T1 auto-trigger logic, T2 practice entry wiring, T3 RoomCoach step predicates, T4 practice/real-sketch separation, O1-O7 opening logic). Zero PAGEERRORs and zero CONSOLE[error]s during the run.

seed_data_creation: Transient localStorage only (same keys as iter_69 plus app_language='de' and ROOM_TUTORIAL_KEY explicitly removed). No sketches saved to disk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To actually drive T1-T4 and O1-O7 live, the next iteration needs testIDs on the toolbar + canvas as listed in action_items. Workarounds without new testIDs: (a) to activate Polygon drawing, click the Polygon icon then look for the small sub-palette (icons '+Pkt' / '-Pkt' / 'Raum' / 'Linie') that appears on top of the canvas and ensure the mode is 'Polygon-Start' before clicking vertex points; a plain click on 'Polygon' label alone did not plot vertices in this run. (b) For long-press on a measured line, iter_69 used page.mouse.down() + await asyncio.sleep(0.9) + page.mouse.up() at a point on the line — this still works ONLY if you first find the line geometry by inspecting the rendered SVG path for the polygon. (c) To bypass the live-drawing problem entirely, seed a ready-made sketch into localStorage ('aufmassprofi_sketches' with an element of type polyline, closed=true, 4 points, and matching lineSegmentMeasurements['<id>-0..3']='4m'/'3m'/'4m'/'3m') and open the editor with ?sketchId=<that id>; then auto-tutorial WON'T fire (previous!==0) but practice mode, openings, geraderücken etc. all become scriptable. For ONLY the auto-tutorial path (T1), the best option is probably to drive the polygon via stored seed with closed=false → use the toolbar 'Element löschen' / 'Bearbeiten' to flip closed=true programmatically via a window.__DEBUG_setPolygon helper (if the main agent is willing to expose one in __DEV__). Items specifically worth main-agent self-test: (1) type a negative offset and confirm the conflict is NOT raised today (medium bug reported); (2) verify step 5 of RoomCoach auto-focuses the diagonal field or update the text; (3) verify deductionM2() excludes openings in conflict — grep 'conflict' in /app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts.
rca_of_issue: None — no outright crash or product-stopping defect was observed. The two flagged bugs (negative offset accepted silently, NaN text accepted silently) are validation gaps in /app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts:47-59 (openingConflict only checks the 'outside' case for start+width > lineMeters, not start<0) and would be fixed by adding a start<0 branch and a parse-failed hint under the input. Neither affects data persistence nor causes a runtime error.
